diagnosis: Pre-generated reports stored in the low-level cache under generated_report_{report_token} are served directly upon request without verifying whether the requesting user owns the report job or belongs to the generating organization. If tokens follow predictable patterns or are leaked, unauthorized users can access confidential export files.
exploit_request:
GET /api/reports/cached-download/rpt_q3_financials_001/ HTTP/1.1
Host: analytics.corp.io
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_contractor_token>
